title.zh: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 聖宗三
title.raw: 卷十二 本紀第十二: 聖宗三 Volume 12 Annals 12: Shengzong 3

sentences.zh: 聖宗三

translations.literal: Shengzong, Part Three
translations.idiomatic: Shengzong, Part Three

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙丑，破束城縣，縱兵大掠。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on yichou day, broke Shucheng County and unleashed troops to plunder extensively.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tonghe, on yichou day of the first spring month, the army broke Shucheng County and let the troops plunder freely.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，次文安，遣人諭降，不聽，遂擊破之，盡殺其丁壯，俘其老幼。

translations.literal: On dingmao day halted at Wen'an, dispatched men to instruct surrender, they did not listen, then attacked and broke it, wholly killed its able-bodied men, and took the old and young captive.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day the court encamped at Wen'an and sent men to call for surrender; when they refused, the army stormed the place, killed all the able-bodied men, and took the old and young captive.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，上還南京。

translations.literal: On wuyin day the Emperor returned to Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Emperor returned to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 己卯，禦元和殿，大賚將士。

translations.literal: On jimao day attended Yuanhe Hall and greatly rewarded officers and soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall and held a great distribution of rewards for officers and soldiers.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，如華林、天柱。

translations.literal: On renchen day went to Hualin and Tianzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day the Emperor went to Hualin and Tianzhu.

sentences.zh: 二月甲午朔，至自天柱。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the jiawu new moon, arrived from Tianzhu.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiawu new moon of the second month the Emperor returned from Tianzhu.

sentences.zh: 三月癸亥朔，幸長春宮，賞花釣魚，以牡丹遍賜近臣，歡宴累日。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the guihai new moon, visited Changchun Palace, admired flowers and fished, bestowed peonies widely on close ministers, and feasted joyfully for several days.
translations.idiomatic: On the guihai new moon of the third month the Emperor visited Changchun Palace, enjoyed flowers and fishing, distributed peonies among his close ministers, and feasted for several days.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以諦居部下拽剌解裏偵候有功，命入禦盞郎君班祗候。

translations.literal: On dingchou day, because zhaila Jieli of Diju's division had merit in scouting, he was ordered into the imperial cup-bearer langjun roster on attendant duty.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day zhaila Jieli of Diju's division was rewarded for scouting merit and assigned to the imperial cup-bearer langjun roster on attendant duty.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸巳朔，幸南京。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on the guisi new moon, visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On the guisi new moon of the fourth summer month the Emperor went to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，上率百僚冊上皇太后尊號曰睿德神略應運啟化承天皇太后；

translations.literal: On dingyou day the Emperor led the hundred officials to confer on the Empress Dowager the honorific title Sagacious Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive to Fortune, Initiating Transformation, Upholding Heaven Empress Dowager;
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Emperor led the hundred officials in conferring on the Empress Dowager the honorific Sagacious Virtue, Divine Strategy, Responsive to Fortune, Initiating Transformation, Upholding Heaven Empress Dowager;

sentences.zh: 禮畢，群臣上皇帝尊號曰至德廣孝昭聖天輔皇帝。

translations.literal: When the rite was complete, the ministers conferred on the Emperor the honorific title Utmost Virtue, Expansive Filial Piety, Illustrious Sage, Heaven-Aided Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished the ministers conferred on the Emperor the honorific Utmost Virtue, Expansive Filial Piety, Illustrious Sage, Heaven-Aided Emperor.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，詔有司條上勛舊，等第加恩。

translations.literal: On wuxu day an edict ordered the offices to list meritorious veterans rank by rank for added favor.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day an edict ordered the offices to register meritorious veterans by rank and extend added favors.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，清暑冰井。

translations.literal: On guichou day summered at Ice Well for coolness.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day the court took the summer retreat at Ice Well.

sentences.zh: 六月壬辰朔，召大臣決庶政。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on the renchen new moon, summoned great ministers to decide general governance.
translations.idiomatic: On the renchen new moon of the sixth month the Emperor summoned senior ministers to decide routine affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 丙申，以耶律蘇為遙郡刺史。

translations.literal: On bingshen day Yelü Su was made Yaozhou prefect.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day Yelü Su was appointed Yaozhou prefect.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊辰，涅剌部節度使撒葛裏有惠政，民請留，從之。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on wuchen day, Niela division military commissioner Sageoli had benevolent administration; the people requested he remain; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen day in the seventh autumn month Niela division military commissioner Sageoli had governed well; when the people asked that he stay, the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 是月，獵平地松林。

translations.literal: That month, hunted at Pingdi Songlin.
translations.idiomatic: That month the Emperor hunted at Pingdi Pine Forest.

sentences.zh: 九月丙戌，幸南京。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingxu day, visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day of the ninth month the Emperor went to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 是冬止焉。

translations.literal: That winter halted there.
translations.idiomatic: That winter the court stayed there.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月庚申，如華林、天柱。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on gengshen day, went to Hualin and Tianzhu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Tonghe, on gengshen day of the first spring month, the Emperor went to Hualin and Tianzhu.

sentences.zh: 二月丁未，奚王籌寧殺無罪人李浩，所司議貴，請貸其罪，令出錢贍浩家，從之。

translations.literal: In the second month, on dingwei day, Xi King Chouning killed the guiltless man Li Hao; the responsible office debated his rank and requested remission of his offense, ordering him to pay money to support Hao's household; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day in the second month Xi King Chouning killed an innocent man, Li Hao; the responsible office, weighing his rank, asked that the offense be forgiven on condition he pay compensation to Hao's family; the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，大同軍節度使、同平章政事劉京致仕。

translations.literal: On jiayin day Datong Army military commissioner and joint associate state counselor Liu Jing retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day Datong Army military commissioner and joint associate state counselor Liu Jing retired.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，休哥奏宋事宜，上親覽之。

translations.literal: In the third month, on jiwei day, Xiuge memorialized Song affairs; the Emperor personally reviewed it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day in the third month Xiuge reported on affairs with Song; the Emperor read the memorial himself.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，以司天趙宗德、齊泰、王守平、邵祺、閻梅從征四載，言天象數有征，賜物有差。

translations.literal: On bingyin day, because Directors of Astronomy Zhao Zongde, Qi Tai, Wang Shouping, Shao Qi, and Yan Mei had followed the campaigns for four years and said celestial signs and numbers had correspondences, objects were granted in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day the Directors of Astronomy Zhao Zongde, Qi Tai, Wang Shouping, Shao Qi, and Yan Mei, who had followed the campaigns for four years reporting that celestial signs matched events, were rewarded according to rank.

sentences.zh: 癸未，李繼遷遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On guiwei day Li Jiqian dispatched envoys to come with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day Li Jiqian of Western Xia sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙未，幸南京。

translations.literal: In summer, fourth month, on yiwei day, visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei day of the fourth summer month the Emperor went to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，胡裏室橫突韓德讓墮馬，皇太后怒，殺之。

translations.literal: On dingyou day Hulishi charged across and startled Han Dewei's horse so that he fell; the Empress Dowager was angry and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day Hulishi galloped across Han Dewei's path and caused him to fall from his horse; enraged, the Empress Dowager had him executed.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸宋國王休哥第。

translations.literal: On wuxu day visited the residence of Song King Xiuge.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor visited the residence of Song King Xiuge.

sentences.zh: 五月癸亥，南府宰相耶律沙薨。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on guihai day, Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Sha died.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the fifth month Southern Chancellery chancellor Yelü Sha died.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌朔，奉聖州言太祖所建金鈴閣壞，乞加修繕。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the bingxu new moon, Fengsheng Prefecture reported that the Golden Bell Pavilion built by Taizu was damaged and requested repairs.
translations.idiomatic: On the bingxu new moon of the intercalary month Fengsheng Prefecture reported that the Golden Bell Pavilion built by Taizu had fallen into disrepair and asked that it be restored.

sentences.zh: 詔以南征，恐重勞百姓，待軍還治之。

translations.literal: An edict said because of the southern campaign, fearing to overburden the people again, repairs would wait until the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: An edict replied that with the southern campaign underway, further burden on the people was to be avoided; repairs would wait until the army returned.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，阿薩蘭回鶻來貢。

translations.literal: On renyin day Aslan Uighurs came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin day the Aslan Uighurs sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，烏隈於厥部以歲貢貂鼠、青鼠皮非土產，皆於他處貿易以獻，乞改貢。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Uwei Yujue division, because their annual tribute of sable and blue rat skins were not local products but all traded from elsewhere to present, requested changed tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Uwei Yujue division reported that the sable and blue rat skins due as annual tribute were not local products but had to be obtained by trade elsewhere; they asked that the tribute be changed.

sentences.zh: 詔自今止進牛馬。

translations.literal: An edict ordered from now on to present only cattle and horses.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered that henceforth they need present only cattle and horses.

sentences.zh: 六月癸亥，党項太保阿剌恍來朝，貢方物。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, on guihai day, Tangut Grand Preceptor Alahuan came to court and presented local goods.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day of the sixth month Tangut grand preceptor Alahuan came to court with local products as tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，諭諸道兵馬備南征攻城器具。

translations.literal: On yichou day instructed the various circuits' horses and troops to prepare siege equipment for the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day an edict ordered the various circuits to ready horses, troops, and siege equipment for the southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，夷離堇阿魯勃送沙州節度使曹恭順還，授於越。

translations.literal: On yiyou day yilibi Arubu returned Sha Prefecture military commissioner Cao Gongshun and was granted yuyue.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day yilibi Arubu escorted Sha Prefecture military commissioner Cao Gongshun home and was granted yuyue.

sentences.zh: 秋七月丙戌，觀市。

translations.literal: In autumn, seventh month, on bingxu day, viewed the market.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day in the seventh autumn month the Emperor viewed the market.

sentences.zh: 己亥，遣南面招討使韓德威討河、湟諸蕃違命者。

translations.literal: On jihai day dispatched Southern Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei to punish the various tribes of the He and Huang regions who disobeyed orders.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Southern Route pacification commissioner Han Dewei was sent to punish disobedient tribes along the He and Huang rivers.

sentences.zh: 賜休哥、排亞部諸軍戰馬。

translations.literal: Granted war horses to the various armies of Xiuge's and Paiya's divisions.
translations.idiomatic: War horses were granted to the armies under Xiuge and Paiya.

sentences.zh: 己酉，駐蹕於洛河。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the imperial presence halted at Luo River.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the court encamped at the Luo River.

sentences.zh: 壬子，加韓德威開府儀同三司兼政事令、門下平章事，東京留守兼侍中、漆水郡王耶律抹只為大同軍節度使。

translations.literal: On renzi day Han Dewei was additionally made Kaifu Yitong Sansi and concurrent director of administrative affairs and chief associate of the Secretariat; Eastern Capital regent and palace attendant, Qishui Commandery King Yelü Mozhi was made Datong Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi day Han Dewei was promoted to Kaifu Yitong Sansi with concurrent director of administrative affairs and chief associate of the Secretariat; Eastern Capital regent, palace attendant, and Qishui Commandery King Yelü Mozhi was made Datong Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，排亞請增置涿州驛傳。

translations.literal: On guichou day Paiya requested adding post stations at Zhuo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou day Paiya asked that post stations be added at Zhuo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 八月丙辰，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, on bingchen day, used a green ox and white horse to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day of the eighth month the court sacrificed a green ox and white horse to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 戊午，休哥與排亞、裊裏曷捉生，將至易州，遇宋兵，殺其指揮使而還。

translations.literal: On wuwu day Xiuge with Paiya and Niaolige captured live prisoners; when about to reach Yi Prefecture they encountered Song troops, killed their commander, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day Xiuge, Paiya, and Niaolige went out to take prisoners; nearing Yi Prefecture they met Song troops, killed their commander, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 庚申，幸黎園溫湯。

translations.literal: On gengshen day visited the warm springs at Liyuan.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen day the Emperor went to the hot springs at Liyuan.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以將伐宋，遣使祭木葉山。

translations.literal: On guihai day, because of impending attack on Song, dispatched envoys to sacrifice at Muye Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day, with an attack on Song imminent, envoys were sent to sacrifice at Muye Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，瀕海女直遣使速魯裏來朝。

translations.literal: On dingchou day coastal Jurchen dispatched envoy Sululi to come to court.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day the coastal Jurchen sent envoy Sululi to court.

sentences.zh: 西北路管押詳穩速撒哥以伐折立、助裏二部，上所俘獲。

translations.literal: Northwest Route overseer xiangwen Susage, for attacking the Zheli and Zhuli two divisions, presented captives to the Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Northwest Route overseer xiangwen Susage, having attacked the Zheli and Zhuli divisions, presented his captives to the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 東路林牙蕭勤德及統軍石老以擊敗女直兵，獻俘。

translations.literal: Eastern Route yulin Xiao Qinde and army commander Shilao, for defeating Jurchen troops, presented captives.
translations.idiomatic: Eastern Route yulin Xiao Qinde and army commander Shilao, having routed Jurchen forces, presented captives.

sentences.zh: 大同軍節度使耶律抹只奏今歲霜旱乏食，乞增價折粟，以利貧民。

translations.literal: Datong Army military commissioner Yelü Mozhi memorialized that this year frost and drought had left food scarce and requested increased price for grain conversion to benefit the poor.
translations.idiomatic: Datong Army military commissioner Yelü Mozhi reported that frost and drought had left the people short of food and asked that grain conversion rates be raised to aid the poor.

sentences.zh: 詔從之。

translations.literal: An edict granted it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was granted.

sentences.zh: 濱海女直遣廝魯裏來修土貢。

translations.literal: Coastal Jurchen dispatched Siluli to come and renew local tribute.
translations.idiomatic: The coastal Jurchen sent Siluli to renew their local tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月丙申，化哥與朮不姑舂古裏來貢。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, on bingshen day, Huage with Zhubugu and Chunguli came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day of the ninth month Huage, Zhubugu, and Chunguli sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 休哥遣詳穩意德裏獻所獲宋諜者。

translations.literal: Xiuge dispatched xiangwen Yideli to present captured Song spies.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuge sent xiangwen Yideli with captured Song spies.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，皇太后幸韓德讓帳，厚加賞賚，命從臣分朋雙陸以盡歡。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Dewei's tent, richly rewarded him, and ordered attending ministers to divide into teams for backgammon to fully enjoy themselves.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the Empress Dowager visited Han Dewei's camp, lavished rewards on him, and had attending ministers divide into teams for backgammon to celebrate.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，幸南京。

translations.literal: On wuxu day visited Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the Emperor went to Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 己亥，有事於太宗皇帝廟。

translations.literal: On jihai day performed rites at Emperor Taizong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the court offered rites at Emperor Taizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 以唐元德為奉陵軍節度使。

translations.literal: Tang Yuande was made Fengling Army military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Tang Yuande was appointed Fengling Army military commissioner.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，祭旗鼓南伐。

translations.literal: On guimao day sacrificed to flags and drums for the southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the court sacrificed to the flags and drums before marching south.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，次涿州，射帛書諭城中降，不聽。

translations.literal: On gengxu day halted at Zhuo Prefecture, shot silk letters instructing the city to surrender, they did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu day the court encamped at Zhuo Prefecture and shot in silk messages calling for surrender; the city refused.

sentences.zh: 冬十月乙卯，縱兵四面攻之。

translations.literal: In winter, tenth month, on yimao day, unleashed troops to attack from four sides.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day of the tenth winter month the army attacked from all four sides.

sentences.zh: 城破乃降，因撫諭其眾。

translations.literal: When the city was broken they then surrendered; thereupon comforted and instructed their multitude.
translations.idiomatic: The city fell and only then surrendered; the court then reassured the populace.

sentences.zh: 駙馬蕭勤德、太師闥覽皆中流矢。

translations.literal: Imperial son-in-law Xiao Qinde and Grand Preceptor Talan were both struck by flying arrows.
translations.idiomatic: Imperial son-in-law Xiao Qinde and grand preceptor Talan were both wounded by arrows.

sentences.zh: 勤德載帝車中以歸。

translations.literal: Qinde was carried in the Emperor's carriage to return.
translations.idiomatic: Qinde was brought back in the imperial carriage.

sentences.zh: 聞宋軍退，遣斜軫、排亞等追擊，大敗之。

translations.literal: Learning the Song army had withdrawn, dispatched Xiezhen, Paiya, and others to pursue and attack, greatly defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: When word came that Song forces had withdrawn, Xiezhen, Paiya, and others were sent in pursuit and routed them.

sentences.zh: 戊午，攻沙堆驛，破之。

translations.literal: On wuwu day attacked Shadui Post and broke it.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu day the army took Shadui Post.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以黑白羊祭天地。

translations.literal: On jisi day used black and white sheep to sacrifice to heaven and earth.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi day black and white sheep were sacrificed to heaven and earth.

sentences.zh: 庚午，以宋降軍分置七指揮，號歸聖軍。

translations.literal: On gengwu day distributed surrendered Song troops into seven commands, titled the Guisheng Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu day surrendered Song soldiers were organized into seven commands as the Guisheng Army.

sentences.zh: 壬申，行軍參謀、宣政殿學士馬得臣言諭降宋軍，恐終不為用，請並放還。

translations.literal: On renshen day marching staff adviser and Xuanyang Hall academician Ma Dechen said that instructing surrendered Song troops, he feared they would never be usable, and requested all be released and returned.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen day marching staff adviser and Xuanyang Hall academician Ma Dechen argued that the surrendered Song troops would never serve reliably and asked that they all be sent home.

sentences.zh: 詔不允。

translations.literal: An edict did not grant it.
translations.idiomatic: The request was denied.

sentences.zh: 丙子，籌寧奏破狼山捷。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Chouning memorialized victory in breaking Lang Mountain.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Chouning reported victory at Lang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，復奏敗宋兵於益津關。

translations.literal: On xinsi day again memorialized defeating Song troops at Yijin Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day he again reported routing Song forces at Yijin Pass.

sentences.zh: 癸未，進軍長城口，宋定州守將李興以兵來拒，休哥擊敗之，追奔五六里。

translations.literal: On guiwei day the army advanced to Changcheng Pass; Song Ding Prefecture garrison commander Li Xing came with troops to resist; Xiuge attacked and defeated him, pursuing the flight five or six li.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei day the army advanced to Changcheng Pass; Song Ding Prefecture commander Li Xing met them with troops; Xiuge routed him and pursued the fugitives five or six li.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申朔，上以將攻長城口，詔諸軍備攻具。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the jiashen new moon, because the Emperor was about to attack Changcheng Pass, an edict ordered the various armies to prepare siege equipment.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiashen new moon of the eleventh month, with an assault on Changcheng Pass imminent, an edict ordered all armies to prepare siege equipment.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，駐長城口，督大軍四面進攻。

translations.literal: On gengyin day encamped at Changcheng Pass and supervised the great army in advancing attack from four sides.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court encamped at Changcheng Pass and directed a full assault from all sides.

sentences.zh: 士潰圍，委城遁，斜軫招之，不降；

translations.literal: The troops broke the siege and abandoned the city in flight; Xiezhen called them, they did not surrender;
translations.idiomatic: The garrison broke and fled the city; Xiezhen called on them to surrender, but they refused;

sentences.zh: 上與韓德讓邀擊之，殺獲殆盡，獲者分隸燕軍。

translations.literal: the Emperor with Han Dewei intercepted and attacked them, killed and captured nearly all; captives were distributed to serve in the Yan army.
translations.idiomatic: the Emperor and Han Dewei intercepted them, killing and capturing nearly all; survivors were distributed among the Yan armies.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，攻滿城，圍之。

translations.literal: On xinmao day attacked Mancheng and besieged it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the army attacked and besieged Mancheng.

sentences.zh: 甲午，拔其城，軍士開北門遁，上使諭其將領，乃率眾降。

translations.literal: On jiawu day took its city; soldiers opened the north gate and fled; the Emperor sent men to instruct their officers, and they then led the multitude to surrender.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day the city fell; soldiers fled through the north gate; the Emperor sent envoys to their commanders, who then led their men in surrender.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，攻下祁州，縱兵大掠。

translations.literal: On wuxu day attacked and took Qizhou, unleashed troops to plunder extensively.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day Qizhou was taken and the troops were let loose to plunder.

sentences.zh: 己亥，拔新樂。

translations.literal: On jihai day took Xinle.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day Xinle was captured.

sentences.zh: 庚子，破小狼山砦。

translations.literal: On gengzi day broke Xiao Lang Mountain fort.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi day the army broke the fort at Xiao Lang Mountain.

sentences.zh: 丁未，宋軍千人出益津關，國舅郎君桃委、詳穩十哥擊走之，殺副將一人。

translations.literal: On dingwei day a thousand Song troops came out of Yijin Pass; imperial maternal uncle langjun Taowei and xiangwen Shige attacked and drove them off, killing one deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei day a thousand Song soldiers sallied from Yijin Pass; imperial maternal uncle langjun Taowei and xiangwen Shige drove them back and killed one deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 己酉，休哥獻黃皮室詳穩徇地莫州所獲馬二十匹，士卒二十人。

translations.literal: On jiyou day Xiuge presented twenty horses and twenty soldiers taken by Huangpishi xiangwen Xundi in patrolling Mo Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day Xiuge presented twenty horses and twenty soldiers captured by Huangpishi xiangwen Xundi while scouting Mo Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 命賜降者衣帶，使隸燕京。

translations.literal: Ordered that surrenderers be granted clothing and belts and made to serve in Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: Surrendered soldiers were given clothing and belts and assigned to Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，西路又送降卒二百餘人，給寒者裘衣。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the western route again sent more than two hundred surrendered soldiers; those who were cold were given fur coats.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the western route sent another two hundred-plus surrendered soldiers; those who lacked warm clothing were given fur coats.

sentences.zh: 以馬得臣權宣徽院事。

translations.literal: Ma Dechen was made acting head of the Xuanhui Court.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Dechen was made acting commissioner of the Xuanhui Court.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅朔，賜皮室詳穩乞得、禿骨裏戰馬。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month, on the jiayin new moon, granted war horses to Pishi xiangwen Qide and Tuguli.
translations.idiomatic: On the jiayin new moon of the twelfth month war horses were granted to Pishi xiangwen Qide and Tuguli.

sentences.zh: 橫帳郎君達打裏劫掠，命杖之。

translations.literal: Horizontal tent langjun Dadali plundered; ordered he be beaten with the staff.
translations.idiomatic: Horizontal tent langjun Dadali was found to have looted and was ordered beaten with the staff.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，畋於沙河。

translations.literal: On bingchen day hunted at Sha River.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the Emperor hunted at the Sha River.

sentences.zh: 休哥獻奚詳穩耶魯所獲宋諜。

translations.literal: Xiuge presented Song spies captured by Xi xiangwen Yelu.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuge turned in Song spies taken by Xi xiangwen Yelu.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣北宰相蕭繼遠等往覘安平。

translations.literal: On dingsi day dispatched Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others to reconnoiter Anping.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi day Northern Chancellery chancellor Xiao Jiyuan and others were sent to scout Anping.

sentences.zh: 侍衛馬軍司奏攻祁州、新樂，都頭劉贊等三十人有功，乞加恩賞。

translations.literal: Palace Guard Horse Army Office memorialized that in attacking Qizhou and Xinle, squad leaders Liu Zan and thirty others had merit and requested added favor and reward.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Guard Horse Army Office reported that in the attacks on Qizhou and Xinle squad leaders Liu Zan and thirty others had distinguished themselves and asked for rewards.

sentences.zh: 是月，大軍駐宋境。

translations.literal: That month, the great army encamped in Song territory.
translations.idiomatic: That month the main army encamped inside Song territory.

sentences.zh: 是歲，詔開貢舉，放高舉一人及第。

translations.literal: That year, an edict opened the tribute examination; candidate Gao Ju alone passed.
translations.idiomatic: That year an edict opened the civil examinations; Gao Ju alone passed.

sentences.zh: 七年春正月癸未朔，班師。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tonghe, spring, first month, on the guiwei new moon, the army withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On the guiwei new moon of the first spring month of the seventh year of Tonghe, the army withdrew.

sentences.zh: 戊子，宋雞壁砦守將郭榮率眾來降，詔屯南京。

translations.literal: On wuzi day Song Jibi Fort garrison commander Guo Rong led the multitude to come and surrender; an edict ordered them garrisoned at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day Song Jibi Fort commander Guo Rong surrendered with his force; an edict ordered them stationed at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，次長城口。

translations.literal: On gengyin day halted at Changcheng Pass.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin day the court encamped at Changcheng Pass.

sentences.zh: 三卒出營劫掠，笞以徇眾，以所獲物分賜左右。

translations.literal: Three soldiers left camp to loot; they were flogged as a warning to the masses, and what they had seized was divided and granted to those at the Emperor's side.
translations.idiomatic: Three soldiers left camp to plunder; they were flogged before the troops as an example, and the loot was divided among those around the Emperor.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，李繼遷與兄繼捧有怨，乞與通好，上知其非誠，不許。

translations.literal: On renchen day Li Jiqian had a grievance with his elder brother Jipeng and begged for restored relations; the Emperor knew it was not sincere and refused.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Li Jiqian, who was at odds with his elder brother Jipeng, asked to restore friendly relations; the Emperor knew the request was insincere and refused.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，諭諸軍趣易州。

translations.literal: On guisi day the armies were ordered to hurry to Yi Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day the court ordered the armies to hurry to Yi Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 己亥，禁部從伐民桑梓。

translations.literal: On jihai day followers of the retinue were forbidden to cut down the people's mulberry trees and ancestral homes.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai day the retinue was forbidden to damage civilians' mulberry trees and homesteads.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，攻易州，宋兵出遂城來援，遣鐵林軍擊之，擒其指揮使五人。

translations.literal: On guimao day Yi Prefecture was attacked; Song troops came out from Suicheng to reinforce; the Iron Forest Army was sent to strike them and five of their commanders were captured.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao day the army attacked Yi Prefecture; Song troops came out from Suicheng to reinforce, and the Iron Forest Army was sent against them and captured five commanders.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，大軍齊進，破易州，降刺史劉墀，守陴士卒南遁，上帥師邀之，無敢出者。

translations.literal: On jiachen day the main army advanced together, took Yi Prefecture, and Prefect Liu Chi surrendered; defending soldiers on the walls fled south; the Emperor led troops to intercept them, and none dared come out.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen day the main army advanced together, broke Yi Prefecture, and Prefect Liu Chi surrendered; the garrison fled south over the walls, and when the Emperor led troops to cut them off none dared emerge.

sentences.zh: 即以馬質為刺史，趙質為兵馬都監。

translations.literal: Ma Zhi was immediately made prefect and Zhao Zhi military superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Zhi was immediately appointed prefect and Zhao Zhi military superintendent.

sentences.zh: 遷易州軍民於燕京。

translations.literal: The people and troops of Yi Prefecture were moved to Yanjing.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers and civilians of Yi Prefecture were relocated to Yanjing.

sentences.zh: 以東京騎將夏貞顯之子仙壽先登，授高州刺史。

translations.literal: Because Xian Shou, son of Tokyo cavalry commander Xia Zhenxian, was first to scale the wall, he was appointed prefect of Gaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: Because Xian Shou, son of Tokyo cavalry commander Xia Zhenxian, was first over the wall, he was appointed prefect of Gaozhou.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，幸易州，禦五花樓，撫諭士庶。

translations.literal: On yisi day the court visited Yi Prefecture, ascended the Five-Flower Tower, and comforted and reassured officials and commoners.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi day the court visited Yi Prefecture, ascended the Five-Flower Tower, and reassured officials and commoners.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以青牛白馬祭天地。

translations.literal: On bingwu day the blue ox and white horse were sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu day the court sacrificed the blue ox and white horse to Heaven and Earth.

sentences.zh: 詔諭三京諸道。

translations.literal: An edict announced policy to the three capitals and the various circuits.
translations.idiomatic: An edict announced policy to the three capitals and the various circuits.

sentences.zh: 戊申，次淶水，謁景宗皇帝廟。

translations.literal: On wushen day the court halted at Lishui and paid respects at Emperor Jingzong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen day the court halted at Lishui and visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.

sentences.zh: 詔遣涿州刺史耶律守雄護送易州降人八百，還隸本貫。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Shouxiong to escort eight hundred Yi Prefecture submitters and return them to their original registers.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Shouxiong to escort eight hundred Yi Prefecture submitters home to their original jurisdictions.

sentences.zh: 己酉，次歧溝，射鬼箭。

translations.literal: On jiyou day the court halted at Qigou and shot ghost arrows.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou day the court halted at Qigou and shot ghost arrows.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，還次南京，六軍解嚴。

translations.literal: On xinhai day the court returned and halted at Nanjing; the six armies stood down.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai day the court returned to Nanjing and the six armies stood down.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子朔，上御元和殿受百官賀。

translations.literal: Second month, renzi new moon: the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall and received the congratulations of the hundred officials.
translations.idiomatic: On the renzi new moon of the second month the Emperor attended Yuanhe Hall and received congratulations from the hundred officials.

sentences.zh: 詔雞壁砦民二百戶徙居檀、順、薊三州。

translations.literal: An edict ordered two hundred households from Jibi Fort to move and settle in Tan, Shun, and Ji prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered two hundred households from Jibi Fort to relocate to Tan, Shun, and Ji prefectures.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，回鶻、于闐、師子等國來貢。

translations.literal: On jiayin day the Uyghur, Khotan, Shizi, and other states came with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day the Uyghur, Khotan, Shizi, and other states came with tribute.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，大饗軍士，爵賞有差。

translations.literal: On yimao day the soldiers were feasted grandly, with titles and rewards granted in differing amounts.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day the court feasted the soldiers and granted titles and rewards according to rank.

sentences.zh: 樞密使韓德讓封楚國王，駙馬都尉蕭寧遠同政事門下平章事。

translations.literal: Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Derang was enfeoffed King of Chu; Imperial Son-in-law Commandant Xiao Ningyuan was made co-chancellor of the Secretariat under the same authority as Chief Councillor.
translations.idiomatic: Commissioner of Military Affairs Han Derang was enfeoffed King of Chu, and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Ningyuan was made co-chancellor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 是日，幸長春宮。

translations.literal: That same day the court visited Changchun Palace.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the court visited Changchun Palace.

sentences.zh: 甲子，詔南征所俘有親屬分隸諸帳者，給官錢贖之，使相從。

translations.literal: On jiazi day an edict ordered that captives from the southern campaign whose kinsmen had been assigned to various tents should be redeemed with official funds so they could be reunited.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day an edict ordered that captives from the southern campaign whose relatives had been assigned to various tents be redeemed with official funds so they could rejoin their families.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，賞南征女直軍，使東還。

translations.literal: On yichou day the Jurchen army of the southern campaign was rewarded and sent east to return.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou day the Jurchen army of the southern campaign was rewarded and sent back east.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，禁舉人匿名飛書，謗訕朝廷。

translations.literal: On bingyin day anonymous letters by examination candidates and slander against the court were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin day anonymous letters by examination candidates and slander against the court were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，吐蕃、党項來賀。

translations.literal: On guiyou day the Tibetans and Tangut came to offer congratulations.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou day the Tibetans and Tangut came to offer congratulations.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，雲州租賦請止輸本道，從之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Yun Prefecture requested that land tax be paid only within its own circuit; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Yun Prefecture asked that land tax be paid only within its own circuit, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以女直活骨德為本部相。

translations.literal: On bingzi day the Jurchen Huogude was made chieftain of his own division.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day the Jurchen Huogude was made chieftain of his own division.

sentences.zh: 分遣巫覡祭名山大川。

translations.literal: Shamans were dispatched separately to sacrifice at famous mountains and great rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Shamans were dispatched separately to sacrifice at famous mountains and great rivers.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，皇子佛寶奴生。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the prince Fobaonu was born.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou day Prince Fobaonu was born.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，阿薩蘭、于闐、轄烈並遣使來貢。

translations.literal: On wuyin day Arsalan, Khotan, and Xialie all sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin day Arsalan, Khotan, and Xialie all sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 三月壬午朔，遣使祭木葉山。

translations.literal: Third month, renwu new moon: envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at Mount Muye.
translations.idiomatic: On the renwu new moon of the third month envoys were sent to sacrifice at Mount Muye.

sentences.zh: 禁芻牧傷禾稼。

translations.literal: Grazing and pasturing that harmed the grain crop were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Grazing and pasturing that damaged the grain crop were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 宋進士十七人挈家來歸，命有司考其中第者，補國學官，餘授縣主簿、尉。

translations.literal: Seventeen Song jinshi came with their families to submit; the authorities were ordered to examine those who had passed at the top level and appoint them National University officers, the rest to be given county recorder or bailiff posts.
translations.idiomatic: Seventeen Song jinshi came with their families to submit; the court ordered examination of top graduates for National University posts, with the rest appointed county recorders or bailiffs.

sentences.zh: 李繼遷遣使來貢。

translations.literal: Li Jiqian sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Li Jiqian sent envoys with tribute.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔知易州趙質收戰亡士卒骸骨，築京觀。

translations.literal: On dinghai day an edict ordered Yi Prefecture administrator Zhao Zhi to gather the bones of soldiers killed in battle and build a victory mound.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai day an edict ordered Yi Prefecture administrator Zhao Zhi to gather the bones of soldiers killed in battle and build a victory mound.

sentences.zh: 戊子，賜於越宋國王紅珠筋線，命入內神帳行再生禮，皇太后賜物甚厚。

translations.literal: On wuzi day yuyue Song King was granted red pearl thread and ordered to enter the inner spirit tent to perform the rebirth rite; the Empress Dowager granted gifts in great abundance.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi day yuyue Song King was granted red pearl thread and ordered to enter the inner spirit tent to perform the rebirth rite; the Empress Dowager gave lavish gifts.

sentences.zh: 以雞壁砦民成廷朗等八戶隸飛狐。

translations.literal: Eight households of Jibi Fort commoners, Cheng Tinglang and others, were assigned to Feihu.
translations.idiomatic: Eight households from Jibi Fort, Cheng Tinglang and others, were assigned to Feihu.

sentences.zh: 己丑，詔免雲州逋賦。

translations.literal: On jichou day an edict remitted Yun Prefecture's tax arrears.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou day an edict remitted Yun Prefecture's tax arrears.

sentences.zh: 乙室王貫寧擊鞠，為所部郎君高四縱馬突死，詔訊高四罪。

translations.literal: Yishi King Guanning played cuju; langjun Gao Si of his command let his horse run wild and knocked him dead; an edict ordered Gao Si's crime investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Yishi King Guanning was playing cuju when langjun Gao Si of his command let his horse run wild and killed him; an edict ordered an inquiry into Gao Si's guilt.

sentences.zh: 丙申，詔開奇峰路通易州市。

translations.literal: On bingshen day an edict ordered the Qifeng road opened to reach Yi Prefecture market.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen day an edict ordered the Qifeng road opened to reach the Yi Prefecture market.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以王子帳耶律襄之女封義成公主，下嫁李繼遷。

translations.literal: On wuxu day the daughter of Prince's Tent Yelü Xiang was enfeoffed Princess Yicheng and given in marriage to Li Jiqian.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu day the daughter of Prince's Tent Yelü Xiang was enfeoffed Princess Yicheng and given in marriage to Li Jiqian.

sentences.zh: 是春，駐蹕延芳澱。

translations.literal: That spring the court encamped at Yanfang Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: That spring the court encamped at Yanfang Marsh.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲寅，還京。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, on jiayin day the court returned to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the fourth summer month the court returned to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，國舅太師蕭闥覽為子排亞請尚皇女延壽公主，許之。

translations.literal: On yimao day Imperial Uncle Grand Preceptor Xiao Talan requested on behalf of his son Paiya marriage to the Princess Yan Shou; it was granted.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao day Imperial Uncle Grand Preceptor Xiao Talan asked on behalf of his son Paiya to marry Princess Yan Shou, and the request was granted.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，謁太宗皇帝廟。

translations.literal: On bingchen day the court paid respects at Emperor Taizong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen day the court visited Emperor Taizong's temple.

sentences.zh: 以御史大夫烏骨領乙室大王。

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Wugu was made to oversee Yishi Great King.
translations.idiomatic: Censor-in-chief Wugu was put in charge of Yishi Great King.

sentences.zh: 己未，幸延壽寺飯僧。

translations.literal: On jiwei day the court visited Yanshou Temple and fed the monks.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei day the court visited Yanshou Temple and fed the monks.

sentences.zh: 甲子，諫議大夫馬得臣以上好擊球，上疏切諫：「臣伏見陛下聽朝之暇，以擊球為樂。

translations.literal: On jiazi day Remonstrance and Review Grand Master Ma Dechen, because the Emperor loved striking the ball, submitted a forceful remonstrance: "Your servant has observed that when Your Majesty is free after attending court, you take striking the ball for pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi day Remonstrance and Review Grand Master Ma Dechen, because the Emperor loved playing cuju, submitted a forceful memorial: "Your servant observes that in leisure after court Your Majesty takes pleasure in striking the ball.

sentences.zh: 臣思此事有三不宜：上下分朋，君臣爭勝，君得臣奪，君輸臣喜，一不宜也；

translations.literal: Your servant considers this matter has three points of unfitness: above and below divide into teams, ruler and minister compete for victory, when the ruler gains the minister snatches away, when the ruler loses the minister rejoices — the first unfitness;
translations.idiomatic: Your servant sees three reasons this is unwise: ruler and subject divide into teams and compete; when the ruler wins a minister steals the credit, and when the ruler loses the ministers rejoice — a first objection;

sentences.zh: 往來交錯，前後遮約，爭心競起，禮容全廢，若貪月杖，誤拂天衣，臣既失儀，君又難責，二不宜也；

translations.literal: Coming and going interweave, front and rear block one another, competitive spirits rise together, ritual deportment is wholly abandoned; if one grasps greedily for the mallet and by mistake brushes the imperial robe, the minister has already lost propriety yet the ruler can hardly reprove — the second unfitness;
translations.idiomatic: Players weave back and forth and block one another, competitive spirits flare up, and ritual deportment is cast aside; if one lunges for the mallet and brushes the imperial robe by mistake, the minister has already lost propriety yet the ruler can hardly reprove him — a second objection;

sentences.zh: 輕萬乘之貴，逐廣場之娛，地雖平，至為堅確，馬雖良，亦有驚蹶，或因奔擊，失其控禦，聖體寧無虧損？

translations.literal: To treat lightly the dignity of the ten-thousand-chariot ruler and pursue the amusement of a broad field — though the ground is level it is very hard, though the horses are good they also start and stumble; or through rush and collision one loses control — can the sacred person truly be without harm?
translations.idiomatic: To treat lightly the dignity of the sovereign and pursue the amusement of a broad field — though the ground looks level it is very hard, and though the horses are good they can still start and stumble; in the rush of play control may be lost — can the sacred person truly escape harm?

sentences.zh: 太后豈不驚懼？

translations.literal: Would the Empress Dowager not be alarmed and afraid?
translations.idiomatic: Would the Empress Dowager not be alarmed and afraid?

sentences.zh: 三不宜也。

translations.literal: The third unfitness.
translations.idiomatic: That is the third objection.

sentences.zh: 臣望陛下念繼承之重，止危險之戲。

translations.literal: Your servant hopes Your Majesty will reflect on the weight of succession and cease this dangerous game.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant hopes Your Majesty will reflect on the weight of succession and cease this dangerous game.

sentences.zh: 」疏奏，大嘉納之。

translations.literal: " When the memorial was submitted, it was greatly praised and accepted.
translations.idiomatic: " When the memorial was submitted, the Emperor greatly praised it and accepted the advice.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，吐渾還金、回鶻安進、吐蕃獨朵等自宋來歸，皆賜衣帶。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Tuhun Huanjin, Uyghur Anjin, Tibetan Duduo, and others who had come from Song to submit were all granted clothing and belts.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao day Tuhun Huanjin, Uyghur Anjin, Tibetan Duduo, and others who had defected from Song were all granted clothing and belts.

sentences.zh: 皇太后謁奇首可汗廟。

translations.literal: The Empress Dowager visited the Qishou Khagan temple.
translations.idiomatic: The Empress Dowager visited the Qishou Khagan temple.

sentences.zh: 丙子，以舍利軍耶律杳為常袞。

translations.literal: On bingzi day Yelü Yao of the Sheli army was made changgun.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi day Yelü Yao of the Sheli army was appointed changgun.

sentences.zh: 己卯，駐蹕儒州龍泉。

translations.literal: On jimao day the court encamped at Longquan in Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao day the court encamped at Longquan in Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 五月庚辰朔，遣宣徽使蒲領等率兵分道備宋。

translations.literal: Fifth month, gengchen new moon: Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling and others were dispatched to lead troops by separate routes to guard against Song.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengchen new moon of the fifth month Commissioner of the Palace Attendants Puling and others were dispatched to lead troops by separate routes against Song.

sentences.zh: 以遙輦副使控骨離為舍利拽剌詳穩。

translations.literal: Yaolian deputy envoy Kongguli was made Sheli zhailie xiangwen.
translations.idiomatic: Yaolian deputy envoy Kongguli was appointed Sheli zhailie xiangwen.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，祭風伯於儒州白馬村。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the Wind Lord was sacrificed to at Baima Village in Ru Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi day the court sacrificed to the Wind Lord at Baima Village in Ru Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 休哥引軍至滿城，招降卒七百餘人，遣使來獻，詔隸東京。

translations.literal: Xiuge led his army to Mancheng, recruited over seven hundred surrendering soldiers, sent envoys to present them; an edict ordered them assigned to Eastern Capital.
translations.idiomatic: Xiuge led his army to Mancheng, recruited more than seven hundred surrendering soldiers, and sent envoys to present them; an edict ordered them assigned to Eastern Capital.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，獵桑乾河。

translations.literal: On xinmao day they hunted along the Sanggan River.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao day the court hunted along the Sanggan River.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，燕京奏宋兵至邊，時暑未敢與戰，且駐易州，俟彼動則進擊，退則班師。

translations.literal: On renchen day Yanjing reported Song troops had reached the border; because of the heat they did not yet dare give battle, but would encamp at Yi Prefecture and, if the enemy moved, advance and strike; if they withdrew, withdraw the army.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen day Yanjing reported that Song troops had reached the border; because of the summer heat they did not yet dare give battle but would encamp at Yi Prefecture and advance if the enemy moved, or withdraw if the enemy retreated.

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌朔，以太師柘母迎合，撾之二十。

translations.literal: Sixth month, gengxu new moon: Grand Preceptor Zhemu, for pandering, was beaten twenty blows.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengxu new moon of the sixth month Grand Preceptor Zhemu was beaten twenty blows for pandering.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，詔燕樂、密雲二縣荒地許民耕種，免賦役十年。

translations.literal: On xinyou day an edict permitted the people to farm wasteland in Yanle and Miyun counties, remitting tax and corvée for ten years.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou day an edict permitted people to farm wasteland in Yanle and Miyun counties and remitted tax and corvée for ten years.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，宣政殿學士馬得臣卒，詔贈太子少保，賜錢十萬，粟百石。

translations.literal: On jiaxu day Xuanzheng Hall academician Ma Dechen died; an edict posthumously granted him Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, ten thousand coins, and a hundred piculs of grain.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu day Xuanzheng Hall academician Ma Dechen died; an edict posthumously granted him Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent, ten thousand coins, and a hundred piculs of grain.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，詔出諸畜賜邊部貧民。

translations.literal: On yihai day an edict ordered livestock distributed to impoverished people of the border tribes.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai day an edict ordered livestock distributed to impoverished people of the border tribes.

sentences.zh: 是月，休哥、排亞破宋兵於泰州。

translations.literal: That month Xiuge and Paiya defeated Song troops at Taizhou.
translations.idiomatic: That month Xiuge and Paiya defeated Song troops at Taizhou.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙酉，禦含涼殿視朝。

translations.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on yiyou day the Emperor attended court at the Cool Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou day in the seventh autumn month the Emperor held court at the Cool Hall.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，以中丞耶律核麥哥權夷離畢，橫帳郎君耶律延壽為御史大夫。

translations.literal: On bingxu day Vice Censor-in-chief Yelü Hemaike was made acting yilibi; Horizontal Tent langjun Yelü Yanshou was made censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu day Vice Censor-in-chief Yelü Hemaike was made acting yilibi, and Horizontal Tent langjun Yelü Yanshou was appointed censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，遣兵南征。

translations.literal: On guisi day troops were dispatched on a southern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi day troops were dispatched on a southern campaign.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以迪離畢、涅剌、烏濊三部各四人益東北路來人婆裏德，仍給印綬。

translations.literal: On jiawu day four men each from the Dilibi, Nielie, and Wuhei divisions were added to Eastern North Road envoy Bolide, and seals and cords were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu day four men each from the Dilibi, Nielie, and Wuhei divisions were added to Eastern North Road envoy Bolide, and seals and cords were granted.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，勞南征將士。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the southern campaign troops and officers were rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou day the court rewarded the southern campaign troops and officers.

sentences.zh: 是日，帝與皇太后謁景宗皇帝廟。

translations.literal: That same day the Emperor and Empress Dowager visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the Emperor and Empress Dowager visited Emperor Jingzong's temple.

sentences.zh: 八月庚午，放進士高正等二人及第。

translations.literal: Eighth month, on gengwu day jinshi Gao Zheng and one other were passed and granted degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, on gengwu day, jinshi Gao Zheng and one other passed the examinations.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，禁罝網捕兔。

translations.literal: Winter, tenth month: snares and nets for catching rabbits were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth winter month snares and nets for catching rabbits were forbidden.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲申，于闐張文寶進內丹書。

translations.literal: Eleventh month, on jiashen day Khotan's Zhang Wenbao presented an inner elixir book.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen day in the eleventh month Khotan's Zhang Wenbao presented an inner elixir book.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲寅，鉤魚於沈子濼。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on jiayin day ice fishing was conducted at Shenzi Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin day in the twelfth month the court went ice fishing at Shenzi Marsh.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，獵於好草嶺。

translations.literal: On guihai day they hunted at Haocao Ridge.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai day the court hunted at Haocao Ridge.
